visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black tank top, welcomes a young man who is sitting on a chair and completely draped in large-cell bubble wrap. They are in a modern living room with wooden floors. (2) The woman holds a tablet and shows it to the man; he points at the screen while they discuss something. (3) The woman stands behind the man and vigorously massages his shoulders through the bubble wrap; the man makes exaggerated pained expressions. (4) The scene cuts to a close-up of a teal-colored silicone facial device (FOREO LUNA 4) being held, showing its textured bristles and control buttons. (5) A woman is seen in a bathroom setting, applying a purple version of the device to her face covered in white soap suds, performing circular motions. (6) Returning to the living room, the woman holds the teal device near the man's face, explaining its features. (7) A close-up shot of a smartphone screen displays the 'FOREO For You' app interface with adjustable settings for 'Cleansing mode'. (8) The man is shown rinsing his face with water from a white basin held by the woman, then looking directly at the camera with a refreshed, happy smile. (9) The woman uses the ridged back of the teal device to massage the man's cheeks and jawline while he closes his eyes. (10) The woman demonstrates the charging port and waterproof nature of the device under running water. (11) In the final comedic scene, the man is now dressed in a white shirt and is 'servicing' the woman, who is now the one draped in bubble wrap.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop BGM with a synthesized beat starts immediately. A female voice speaks with a high pitch and an excited greeting. (2) Sounds of rustling plastic or bubble wrap occur as the male speaker enters with a neutral conversational tone. (3) A sudden 'pop' sound effect matches the bubble wrap theme. The female voice becomes more melodic and playful while the male voice responds with exaggerated gasps of pain. (4) The audio transitions as the female voice takes on a professional marketing tone, speaking clearly about technical specifications over the persistent upbeat rhythm. (5) Digital 'ding' sound effects punctuate mentions of specific features. (6) Sound of water splashing and rhythmic rubbing noises are mixed in as the male character exclaims in delight. (7) A clear 'click' sound effect occurs during the app demonstration phase. (8) The video ends with a comical dialogue exchange and a final melodic chime as the track fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Sketch -> Product Hook -> Demo -> Benefits -> Final Twist.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the FOREO LUNA 4 facial cleanser by demonstrating its effectiveness and ease of use through a humorous 'service' scenario between a couple.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, detailed feature walkthrough, and app integration demonstration.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively blends social media comedy with traditional product endorsement. The 'bubble wrap' metaphor for delicate skin and the role-reversal ending add high engagement value for a young audience.
